profile.name: Fransua León Sánchez
profile.headline: Ssr. Cloud Engineer · AI Systems Builder
about: I build reliable Cloud AI platforms at the intersection of infrastructure, agentic systems, and production machine learning.
I turn multimodal and multi-cloud AI systems into production platforms with clear reliability, security, and cost boundaries.

research.narrative: I focus on the engineering layer that turns AI prototypes into observable, secure, cost-aware production systems: agent orchestration, retrieval, cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery.

focus.name: Cloud AI Architecture
focus.description: Production AI platforms across GCP, AWS, and Azure with security, scalability, and cost control.

focus.name: Agentic Systems
focus.description: Tool-using, retrieval-augmented, and multimodal agents built for measurable real-world workflows.

focus.name: MLOps & SRE
focus.description: Infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, reliability engineering, and operational governance.

focus.name: Multimodal AI
focus.description: Real-time voice, vision, and language experiences using modern model and media infrastructure.

projects.name: GEMA Digital Twin
projects.summary: A digital metabolic twin for early-risk screening in Peru, combining an interpretable metabolic-load index, ML predictions, and what-if guidance.

projects.name: GenIA Voice RAG

projects.name: HealthIA

projects.name: RIMAC Alerts
